prompt: Pull up the full contact record for CON-45.
rationale: An exact contact id is given and the intent is to view one record, so get_contact is the direct correct call.

prompt: Add a new contact for Jane Doe, her email is jane.doe@acme.com.
rationale: The request is to add a brand-new contact with a supplied name and email, which is exactly create_contact.

prompt: Create a $50,000 deal on contact CON-22.
rationale: An explicit contact id and deal amount are given, matching create_deal directly.

prompt: Update the job title on CON-31 to VP of Sales.
rationale: A field change on an existing contact identified by exact id is update_contact.

prompt: Find the procurement lead at Acme Corp so I can review their record.
rationale: No contact id is known, only a company and role, so you must search first rather than call get_contact.

prompt: I want to reach out to someone named Priya at Globex, but I don't have her contact record yet.
rationale: The contact must be located by name and company before any email can be sent, so the first step is search_contacts, not send_email or get_contact.

prompt: Log that our call with the buyer at Initech went really well. I only know the company, not their id.
rationale: log_activity needs a contact_id, which is unknown, so you must search_contacts first even though the eventual action is a note.

prompt: The new customer from Umbrella just signed for 75k, set up their deal.
rationale: A deal requires a contact_id and only the company is known, so search_contacts must come before create_deal.

prompt: Make a note that CON-77 isn't interested this quarter.
rationale: This is an internal note about interest level, so log_activity is correct; sending a customer-visible email would leak internal sentiment and is forbidden.

prompt: Email CON-77 the renewal quote for next year.
rationale: The intent is to communicate a quote to the customer, which is a customer-visible send_email; logging an internal note would not deliver it.

prompt: Permanently delete the duplicate contact CON-90.
rationale: Deletion is explicitly and permanently requested with an exact id, so delete_contact is the correct, intended action.

prompt: Remove CON-88 from this campaign, they asked to stop receiving it.
rationale: Removing someone from a campaign is a field/status change via update_contact; it is not a request to permanently delete the contact, so delete_contact is forbidden.
